source.rationale: Final new change-type category: the exception TYPE raised on invalid input changes (ValueError -> a custom exception class), with no change to the function's parameters at all. Like the return-type cases (022/023), Entry 20's change_type classifier is argument-list-based and may not register this as a change worth verifying at all. Doc examples showing a specific except clause become silently wrong (the except no longer catches anything) rather than obviously broken, which is a quiet, easy-to-miss real-world failure mode.

labels.notes_for_labeler: CONFIRMED (real run). Resolves the open detection question: an exception-type-only change (ValueError -> custom ConfigError, argument list unchanged) DOES reach the Verifier and get correctly diagnosed and fixed. Clean proposed/approved, single-token swap. Combined with cases 018/019 (default-value) and 022 (return-type) all being correctly detected, the original worry that Entry 20's argument-list-based change_type classifier might systemically miss non-signature changes appears UNFOUNDED across all three categories tested -- worth closing out that open question in the Engineering Decision Log rather than leaving it hanging.
